title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
label: Edison Record (2-min cylinder)
license: Public domain (US) — recorded 1908, UCSB: pre-1923 cylinders free for any use, commercial or non-commercial (cylinders.library.ucsb.edu/licensing.php)
attribution: Optional courtesy credit: University of California, Santa Barbara Library (UCSB Cylinder Audio Archive), Cylinder 13785
notes: PRIMARY. Original 1908 hit-era vocal waltz. Noisy acoustic cylinder (heavy surface hiss, hf-dominant). Announcement + intro ~0-5s, verse 1, chorus, verse 2, chorus to end. Chroma self-similarity: ~40-60s repeats at ~89-109s (one verse+chorus cycle = ~49s), so chorus 1 is roughly 41-65s and final chorus ~89-114s. Alt chorus 1: [41,65]. Confidence medium (estimated by repetition analysis, not by ear).
